features: Replaces the fragile admin projection iframe chain with a dedicated read-only live-display/feed.php endpoint
Projector PC now renders the current event, round, feed type, page and podium reveal directly from the secure Live Display session
Holding, Judges, Competitors, Scoring, Callbacks, Finalists, Winner Podium and Final Ranking now use the same single projector URL workflow
Remote state polling remains at 750ms and reloads the dedicated feed whenever state_version changes
State endpoint now returns session state only and no longer constructs admin projection URLs
Winner podium reveal state remains session-driven for 5th, 4th, 3rd, 2nd, 1st and Full Podium
Results Reveal Safety remains enforced server-side before protected feeds can render
No scoring calculation, results or official BDC points logic changed
No Staging or Production deployment performed
